# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Removed the unused public `temp_repro_factor_pub` wrapper from `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, keeping the temperature reproduction helper internal and eliminating the dead public API surface without changing runtime behavior.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect `shrimp.rs` and workspace usages to confirm whether `temp_repro_factor_pub` was real API or dead test-access scaffolding.
2. [Completed] Remove the unused public wrapper and leave `temp_repro_factor` as the internal helper used by reproduction-readiness logic.
3. [Completed] Run targeted and package-level validation to confirm the API cleanup does not change reproduction behavior or break `tank_core` builds.

## Validation Evidence

- `rg -n "temp_repro_factor_pub" -S .` returned no matches after the edit.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` passed (13/13).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` package test suite.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation was scoped to the `tank_core` package; I did not rerun a full workspace-wide test suite.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings` still fails on pre-existing unrelated test-target lint issues in `crates/tank_core/tests/source_water_carbonate.rs` and `crates/tank_core/tests/molt_mineral_budget.rs`.
